static_traits.name: Zhou Min
static_traits.social_status: Weak social support (no specific person to confide in)
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy history; no similar problem history yet
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic; depressed and self-blaming tone; highly cooperative; repeated checking and cautious behavior appear in work and study tasks

basic_info.main_problem: After misspelling a patient's name at Work, I keep experiencing Self-doubt and inadequacy.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these Self-doubts affect my confidence at Work and in Learning; I just want to feel capable again, whether at Work or in Learning.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough, not competent enough.
I am essentially an inattentive person.

special_situations.event: While working at the DoctorOffice, misspelled a patient's name due to a busy, high-load day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake, it means I am not competent; I am just an inattentive person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles focus and repeatedly proofreads, makes checklists to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough; I am not competent for this Work

special_situations.event: Later facing tasks requiring high attention to detail at work or in study
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must achieve zero errors and absolute focus to count as qualified and trustworthy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Slowing down, constantly double-checking every detail
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should have been more focused; there should not be any mistakes

special_situations.event: Thinks about whether colleagues or patients will still trust oneself with important tasks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not trust me, it proves I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintains others' trust in oneself through excessive caution and repeated checking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: People will no longer trust me with important things

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be trusted and recognized as capable; to maintain competence in work and studies
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated for one mistake, being seen as unreliable, thus losing others' trust
defense_goal: Controls errors through self-criticism and over-checking, maintaining safety and a sense of acceptance

object_relations.self_representation: Not competent enough, someone prone to mistakes
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges / untrusting others (such as colleagues, patients)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others ask about and evaluate her work mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing evaluation as negation and distrust, believing one must achieve zero errors to not be negated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming statements (such as 'It is all my fault'), emphasizing one's own flaws, in a guilty, low tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing how to improve and making specific processes or checklists
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Reducing emotional exposure by rationalizing processes, believing that being careful enough can avoid being negated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Discusses steps and rules in objective, technical language, downplays emotional wording, maintains a calm and neutral tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to try new strategies and accept possible imperfection
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Anticipating the consequences of failure and being distrusted, trying to Interpretation with external factors to ease Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes reasons such as being busy with work and objective environmental limits, retaining doubtful and worried wording (such as 'but I might still make mistakes').

manifestations: Having no specific person to confide in for support; bearing overwhelm and Self-doubt alone after the mistake
outcomes: Intensifying self-doubt, Increased stress and anxiety, declining focus and overall sense of well-being

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly self-examines and checks work/study tasks many times
Evaluating oneself with 'I am not good enough / incompetent'
Being overly cautious about mistakes, fearing others' distrust

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Worrying others will not trust oneself (attributing distrust to others)
Assumes others will negatively evaluate one's competence

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Redirects the energy of avoiding mistakes into self-restraint (repeated checking and redoubled caution)
Lacks outward help-seeking behavior; copes with stress mostly through self-demands

positive_force: Willing to actively seek counseling and help
Able to identify situational factors (e.g., the impact of a busy Work day on the mistake)
Willing to try strategies like checklists and double-checking
Has motivation and expectations for improving work and study ability
negative_force: Labeling and self-deprecation (equating one mistake with incompetence)
Excessive checking and hesitation leading to energy drain and Increased stress
Lacking Social support, insufficient emotion-regulation resources
Tending to mind-read and worry about others' distrust

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly checking and hesitating in work and study tasks (overly cautious safety behaviors)
antecedent: Facing tasks requiring high attention to detail
Recalling the incident of misspelling a patient's name
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing about making mistakes again and worrying about others' distrust (generalizing one mistake into incompetence)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential mistakes and negative evaluations, briefly reducing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Energy depletion, Decreased efficiency, Increased stress, further weakening focus and confidence

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-talk and self-labeling ('I am not good enough / I am an inattentive person')
antecedent: Being reminded of or thinking about past mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief generalizing a single mistake into overall incompetence, Confluence of shame and Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Using self-criticism to push oneself to be more careful and controlled, but actually reinforcing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, declining focus, further reliance on safety behaviors like excessive checking
